name: print-social-trendy-wordmark-over-blue-sky-selfie
title: Bubbly white script wordmark sweeping over a sunglasses selfie against blue sky, lime blob corner
whatItIs: A low-angle photo of a woman in blue wrap sunglasses and a blue fur collar under a deep blue sky. A thick white swash lettering 'Trendly' with a long underline curve crosses the top, small caps 'FASHION LIKE' above and a lime flower-shaped blob in the lower left.
whatItMeans: Fresh and fashionable; monochrome blue makes the lime blob and white logo pop.
techniques: Colour-match wardrobe and background in one blue.
Curve a thick wordmark with a swoosh under it.
Add a single lime organic shape as accent.

vocabulary.definition: A small organic shape in a contrasting colour.
An image dominated by one hue.
